title: Two Step and Country Swing Dance Class in Nashville Country
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Only place in Nashville where you can learn from the best and learn to two step and country swing. Take your moves out to the Honky Tonks and this is something you will have forever. What you learn in class you can take home and now dance at weddings and events. You can also Zoom with us to continue learning. Learn to lead and follow, two step basics, and country swing moves. Teaching is based on your skill level.
